findings.detail: W2_RECEIVE_RECEIPT.json self-reports check 'seal_manifest_binding' ok with ea5aaa2566c7b7c7a13bc55d893675b936653e22b6864f359368f3eed0ac5c49, but the delivered EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json recomputes to cd0ca55ebcd1d4d077eaf0802122c78c19c5d9aebd40250f548ae5ff2b41082e (equal to DELIVERY_SEAL.evidence_manifest_sha256). The ea5aaa value matches neither the raw bytes nor LF-normalized or canonical-JSON forms of the delivered manifest, so the receipt binds a different manifest revision. make_delivery4.py loads the W2 receipt and then rewrites closeout/handoff/changeset and regenerates the manifest (lines 261-286), and the receipt timestamp (15:21:20Z) precedes the seal (15:21:41Z).

9 of 117 closure rows cite an independent_check.json artifact that does not exist anywhere in the delivery, pack, or evidence tree. One of them (P06) carries verdict EVIDENCED, i.e. a pass-equivalent claim whose evidence reference cannot be resolved. The other 8 are COVERED_BY_SHARED_OPERATION.

findings.detail: The second host package was served a contract with subject equal to the literal string 'None' and next_action null; pkg2.value_check is null, so no subject/scope/fixture join was performed for it, yet its stage row and the global ledger still record Bound/Invoked/ActualServed/Consumed as OBSERVED_LOCAL. The receipt contains only one global stage_evidence block (Invoked argv for work_b / W0) and one served text sha, so package A has no per-package served digest in the receipt.

In all 20 case rows source_sha equals pack_sha (both the pack pin 61f34a08...). The six digest fields are not all identical (candidate_sha 681fe5b6..., case_set_sha256 63a59b87..., per-case oracle and evidence differ), so the required 'not all the same' split holds, but two of the six declared domains collapse.

Evidence run id 20261125T232032 (cases.json, host_receipt.json) differs from the delivery/manifest/seal run id 20261125T232008. This is consistent with a later evidence sub-run packaged into the delivery, but the ids are not unified.

The 7-stage ledger is byte-identical in the global ledger and in both packages, and only two distinct values occur (OBSERVED_LOCAL x6, REASONED_NA_NATIVE_ENTRY x1). stage_evidence provides distinct per-stage detail, so this is not proof of hardcoding, but the per-package rows carry no independent per-package evidence.
